Corning’s Display Technologies segment manufactures glass substrates for active matrix liquid crystal displays (“LCDs”) that are used primarily in LCD televisions, notebook computers and flat panel desktop monitors.

- Develop data-driven go-to-market and investment strategies

- Partner with leaders across business, technology, and finance to identify and prioritize growth opportunities

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Science, or related required

- 3+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, business transformation, or corporate development

- Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous business challenges using data-driven insights

- Proven experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across functions

- Track record of leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes

- Demonstrated leadership in managing project & people across functions and regions

- Seasoned in technological areas, ability to engage in technology discussions

Experiences/Education - Desired

- MBA or advanced degree in science and technology

Corning’s businesses are ever-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:

- Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected

- Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light

- Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences

- Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation

Job Responsibilities:

Portfolio Pricing:

- Lead and advance pricing tools within Gorilla Glass to ensure a design that is sustainable given Gorilla Glass’ inherent business model complexity and future growth expectations

- Perform scenario analyses to understand the financial and commercial impact of potential changes

- Analyze market trends, competitive pricing, and customer feedback to adjust pricing strategies effectively.

- Build set of recommendations through strong analytical work in order to improve Gorilla Glass price and market position

Strategy and Forecasting:

- Lead long-term strategic projects related to the improvement of our global pricing

- Work closely with forecasting team to define budget and 5-year plan, identify key market drivers and suggest strategy to maximize our share, revenue and margin

- Monitor pricing performance and conduct regular reviews to assess the impact of pricing strategies on revenue and profitability.

- Prepare detailed reports and presentations for senior management, outlining pricing performance and recommendations for improvement.

Commercial Proposal negotiations:

- Lead alignment with account teams on pricing execution and contract negotiation strategy, based on portfolio pricing analysis

- Present the key findings to the business leadership and drive the approval process on specific negotiation actions

- Ensure pricing strategies comply with company policies, legal requirements, and ethical standards.

- Implement and maintain pricing governance frameworks to manage pricing approvals and escalations.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

- Work closely with sales, product line management, forecasting, marketing, and finance teams to align pricing strategies with business goals

- Provide pricing guidance and support to regional sales and product management teams during contract negotiations and customer engagements

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, a technical discipline, or a related field.

- 3+ years of commercial experience

- Strong business acumen and analytical skills, ability to dig into detail, manage complexity and drive decision making

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Self-starter, capable of fully owning a complex strategy project with limited supervision

- Ability to think outside of the box and bring innovative ideas to the pricing and product line teams

- Demonstrated self-confidence, ability to effectively communicate and influence senior management

- Potential to grow into commercial leadership roles

- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint

- Process oriented, ability to lead reengineering of processes

- Ability to reinforce contracts and defend tough decisions

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey pricing strategies and recommendations

- Proven ability to work collaboratively with various departments and stakeholders to achieve common goals

- Ability and willingness to work in the evenings to engage with international colleagues (multiple nights per week; weekdays only)

Desired Skills/Experience:

- MBA or other Master degree equivalent experience

- Technical undergrad

- Strategy project experience

- Pricing and/or commercial experience

- Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.
Purpose

The Program Manager will lead large, complex engineering initiatives that are critical to business execution and long-term growth. This role will initially primarily support major Capacity Expansion programs, but may also provide leadership across other strategic initiatives, including Automation, New Product Introduction, and Cost Reduction efforts. These responsibilities may evolve based on business priority changes.

This is a global role with responsibility for coordinating programs across key regions and sites, including the United States, Mexico, China, and Poland. The Program Manager will drive alignment across cross-functional and cross-regional teams, translate strategic priorities into executable plans, and lead disciplined execution across technical, operational, and capital-related workstreams.

This role also plays a critical part in program governance at the divisional level. The Program Manager must be able to communicate high-level program strategies, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to the Division Executive Leadership Team and lead effective decision-making at the steering team level. Success in this role requires the ability to frame complex issues clearly, present strategic options, and help leaders make strong, timely decisions that keep programs aligned with business priorities

Responsibilities

•    Manage programs with global scope, coordinating teams, stakeholders, and execution activities across the United States, Mexico, China, and Poland; provide program leadership across a broad portfolio of strategic initiatives, including Automation, New Product Introduction, and Cost Reduction projects.
•    Translate business and engineering opportunities and initiatives into clear program strategies, objectives, deliverables, milestones, and execution plans to drive alignment across engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, and other cross-functional teams
•    Lead efforts to secure necessary capital funds to execute large scale programs through effective use of Corning capital management tools, methods, and processes

•    Prepare executive-level communications on program strategies, risks, tradeoffs, and key decision needs to the Division Executive Leadership Team, including recommendations that clearly outline options, business impacts, execution risks, and proposed paths forward for critical decisions
•    Establish strong program governance - including milestone reviews, decision forums, risk management, action tracking, scope change management, program performance metrics, and stakeholder communication to promote standard program management best practices and methods, and drives continuous improvement across the portfolio
•    Lead large, high-impact engineering programs and teams (10 members or more) with primary initial focus on Capacity Expansion initiatives

Travel requirements:
•    Up to 20-25% travel in the US, China, Mexico or Poland depending on the program requirements and timing

Qualifications

•    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field
•    10+ years) in program management, project management, engineering, manufacturing, or technical operations.  Includes supervisory or managerial experience demonstrating success leading large, cross-functional or cross-regional programs and teams with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and significant business impact
•    Experience leading programs involving capital projects above $10M, manufacturing operations, technical implementation, or operational improvement; which demonstrates ability to adapt across multiple project types based on business priorities, and drive alignment and execution in a matrixed organization
•    6+ years of experience with Automation, New Product Introduction, and/or Cost Reduction initiatives involving experience leading or supporting Capacity Expansion programs in an engineering or manufacturing environment

•    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated ability to engage technical teams, site leadership, and senior leadership to communicate strategic program direction, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership to support executive and steering team decision-making through clear analysis, structured communication, and sound judgment, and demonstrating ability to influence without direct authority

Desired Skills, Abilities, and Experience

•    Completion of formal project management training with further preference for Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
•    Six Sigma Black Belt and/or Lean training, experience or certification
•    Early stage innovation training (LFM) for new product introductions (NPI)

The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

Key Responsibilities
1.Program Strategy & End-to-End Ownership
• Lead and manage medium-to-large scale supply chain transformation programs, such as global supplier consolidation, inventory optimization, lead-time reduction, logistics network redesign, S&OP process implementation, ERP/WMS system rollout, or new market supply chain setup.
• Define program scope, roadmap, milestones, success metrics, and deliverables aligned with company business objectives.
• Own full program lifecycle: initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure and post-implementation review.
2.Cross-Functional Stakeholder Leadership
• Collaborate closely with procurement, planning, production, logistics, quality, finance, sales, IT and regional business teams.
• Align cross-regional and cross-department stakeholders, drive consensus, resolve conflicts, and ensure program execution on schedule.
• Report program progress, risks, issues and outcomes to senior leadership regularly.
3.Risk Management & Issue Resolution
• Identify supply chain program risks including supplier risks, capacity constraints, logistics disruptions, inventory volatility, compliance and lead-time risks.
• Develop mitigation plans, contingency strategies and escalation mechanisms.
• Resolve critical roadblocks during program delivery to avoid delays or business impact.
4.Performance Tracking, Cost & KPI Optimization
• Establish program KPIs: on-time delivery improvement, inventory turnover increase,
working capital reduction, logistics/procurement cost savings, supplier OTIF rate, fill rate improvement.
• Monitor program budget, track cost-saving targets, and ensure program ROI.
• Conduct data analysis and root-cause analysis to drive continuous supply chain
process improvements.
5.Supplier & Global Supply Chain Collaboration
• Engage key strategic suppliers in joint improvement programs, capacity planning and risk sharing.
• Support global supply chain standardization, process harmonization and best-practice rollout across regions.
• Drive sustainability and compliance initiatives within supply chain programs where required.
6.Process Standardization & Change Management
• Design and roll out standardized supply chain SOPs, governance frameworks and project management tools.
• Lead change management, training and adoption of new processes, systems or ways of working across teams.

Education & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree or above in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Operations Management or related fields; MBA preferred.
• 5–8 years progressive supply chain experience with at least 3+ years program / project management experience in end-to-end supply chain covering APAC or other regions, countries.
• Global enterprise and high-tech/manufacturing industry background preferred.
• PMP / APICS CPIM / CSCP certification is a plus.

Required Skills
• Deep understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes: demand planning, S&OP, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, logistics, order management.
• Strong program management skills: scope control, timeline management, stakeholder management, risk management and budget tracking.
• Proficient in ERP systems (SAP/Oracle), MS office, experience with supply chain digital tools & analytics, Power BI/Tableau and advanced Excel for performance tracking.
• Proven track record delivering large-scale cross-regional supply chain programs; deep understanding of APAC supply chain ecosystem, procurement, demand planning, inventory management, logistics, manufacturing and supplier management.
• Strong program management capability: scope control, schedule management, risk management, budget control, cross-team coordination.
• Working experience in multiple APAC countries or regional HQ role. Excellent cross-cultural communication and negotiation skills for global/regional collaboration.
• Excellent English verbal & written communication (business fluent); able to work effectively in multi-cultural, multi-time-zone global environment.
• Experience with global supply chain transformation, digitalization, AI demand forecasting.

Desired Skills
• PMP, CSCP, CLTD, Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus.

Soft Skills
• Strong leadership, strategic thinking and execution-oriented mindset.
• Excellent problem-solving, decision-making and multi-tasking ability under pressure.
• High sense of ownership, result-driven and detail-oriented.
• Change management mindset with strong teamwork and influencing skills.

jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 76743

The company built on breakthroughs. ​
Join us.​

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.  ​

Come break through with us.

Corning’s businesses are ever-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:

- Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives

- Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected

- Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light

- Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences

- Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation

- Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low-cost solar energy solutions

Role purpose

The Supplier Quality Programs Manager is the division-level leader responsible for developing, implementing, and governing a standardized Supplier Quality Management (SQM) operating model across all Advanced Optics sites. This role owns the supplier quality strategy, framework, standards, metrics, governance, and continuous improvement roadmap required to build a consistent, high-performing supplier quality program.This position establishes and governs a common operating model for supplier qualification, incoming inspection, defect management, supplier corrective actions, supplier performance monitoring, escalation, and supplier development. The role is accountable for reducing site-to-site variability, improving supplier accountability, and increasing enterprise-wide visibility into supplier quality risks and performance trends.

The Supplier Quality Programs Manager serves as both a strategic program leader and a hands-on subject matter expert, partnering closely with Global Supply Management, Procurement, Engineering, Operations, and Site Quality teams. Success in this role will be measured by the implementation of standardized supplier quality processes across sites, improved supplier performance, stronger governance, and measurable reduction in supplier-related quality risk.

Key responsibilities

-
Lead the development, implementation, and governance of the Advanced Optics Supplier Quality Management program across all sites, establishing a standardized operating model for supplier quality processes, metrics, and performance management.

-
Define and maintain enterprise supplier quality standards and processes, including supplier defect management, incoming inspection data requirements, corrective action expectations, escalation pathways, and reporting practices.

-
Develop and sustain supplier quality KPIs, scorecards, and reporting mechanisms that provide clear visibility into supplier performance, quality trends, and business risk.

-
Partner cross-functionally with Global Supply Management, Procurement, Engineering, Operations, and Site Quality teams to drive supplier accountability, improve supplier capability, and reduce supplier-related quality issues.

-
Lead the escalation and structured resolution of critical supplier quality issues, ensuring timely containment, effective corrective action, and appropriate leadership visibility.

-
Analyze supplier quality performance across sites to identify systemic issues, standardization opportunities, and continuous improvement priorities.

-
Support supplier qualification, audit, and development activities as needed to strengthen supplier performance and ensure alignment with quality system expectations.

-
Develop and maintain the documentation, tools, and training materials required to sustain consistent execution of the supplier quality program across the division.

Required Qualifications

-
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Supply Chain, or a related technical or business field

-
7+ years of experience in supplier quality, manufacturing quality, or related roles

-
Prior program management or cross-functional leadership experience

-
Experience driving quality improvement across multiple manufacturing sites or business units

-
Strong expertise in supplier quality management within a manufacturing environment, including supplier corrective actions, incoming quality, defect management, and supplier performance monitoring.

Desired Qualifications

-
Lean / Six Sigma certification or demonstrated capability (Green Belt or Black Belt) preferred.

-
Project management experience, including project charters, milestone planning, stage gates, and disciplined execution across cross-functional initiatives.

-
Experience improving workflow and reporting processes through standardized templates, controlled documentation, dashboards, and lightweight automation tools.

Travel Rquirements

-
Travel up to 15%, primarily domestic, to support division and site-level business needs

Sccope of Position

Early-in-career Track: The purpose of the HRLDP is to provide early-in-career professionals with a foundational competency base in various facets of HR.

Corning's Human Resources Leadership Development Program (HRLDP) is a special initiative focused on developing the company's future HR leaders. Unlike typical HR rotational programs, the HRLDP is crafted to mold you into a leader by providing a broad perspective of Corning's global business segments through various roles and tasks. The journey intertwines your individual career aspirations with the business objectives of Corning. This design allows you to venture into different areas of HR early in your career with Corning, enabling you to establish a wide network and gain extensive organizational knowledge. To ensure comprehensive development, the program offers a range of enriching experiences. These include initial onboarding workshops, sessions with mentors and coaches, training in leadership and functional skills, and the chance to interact and learn from business leaders throughout the company.

The HR Leadership Development Program is a three-year program consisting of three rotational assignments, with a key focus on Business Unit HR (BUHR) generalist assignments and plant-based HR support, complemented with assignments within Corning HR’s Center of Excellence (COE) groups. BUHR assignment(s) will place participants in generalist roles supporting a Business, Plant, and/or Corporate Function, providing both strategic and operational support to the HR leader while building strong business partnership capabilities in manufacturing and plant environments. COE assignment(s) may include experience in Talent Management (i.e., Staffing, Talent Planning), Compensation & Benefits, Employee Relations, and/or Operations & Analytics.

Key Responsibilities

Business Unit HR (BUHR) Specialist
1. Effectively deploying hiring processes
2. Educating plant leadership on union contracts and local and state employment law to ensure compliance with contracts and applicable personnel management laws
3. Managing and mitigating employee grievances by ensuring supervisors and leadership are creating an open forum for discussion and resolution of plant issues
4. Coaching and counseling Business/Plant management in development and demonstration of leadership and management practices required to establish and maintain a positive work environment
5. Resolving employee relations issues in a fair and consistent manner that protects the needs of the Business/Plant to operate in an effective and efficient manner
6. Taking ownership for specific HR initiatives that support the effective operations of the organization by developing and/or delivering HR programs (e.g., attendance tracking, training, communications)
7. Tracking and documenting employment issues and requests (e.g., FMLA, workers compensation) as required for procedural and legislative purposes
8. Implementing appropriate risk management policies and procedures to ensure Business/Plant compliance with safety requirements and local, state, and federal employment laws

COE Specialist

1. Implementing COE programs / processes / policies in compliance with current legal and regulatory policies and assesses them to determine the extent to which they support Corning Values and positive work environment
2. Researching external market practices to identify opportunities for continuous improvement to better meet corporate, business, function, and employee needs
3. Gathering and analyzing data on the performance and impact of COE programs / processes / policies, highlighting areas of concern or improvement, and creating reports and presentations as requested to ensure achievement of targeted results
4. Recommending areas for standardization of COE programs / processes / policies, as appropriate, to reduce complexity of administration and associated costs
5. Collaborating with BUHR partners and other COEs to leverage their expertise to expedite integration of business-relevant COE programs / processes / policies / systems
6. Interacting with vendors per service level agreement, as needed, to maximize delivery of outsourced services

Requirements

- 3-year commitment to the rotational program

- Firm Fixed Price

- Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP)

- Turnkey

- Cost-Plus Fixed Fee

- Time & Material

- Unit Price

- Shared Savings Contracts

jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 78891

The company built on breakthroughs. ​
Join us.​

Come break through with us.

The Global Supply Management (GSM) Function is recognized as a critical function for business success.  It delivers the training, tools and opportunities needed to create innovative solutions for the function & the corporation.  GSM has leading edge, effective processes to anticipate and exceed customer requirements.
Purpose of the Position

The Procurement Operations Senior Specialist is an experienced procurement operations professional responsible for independently managing complex transactional work, resolving escalated procurement issues, and supporting reliable, compliant, and customer-focused Requisition-to-Pay (R2P) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) service delivery.

The Senior Specialist partners with Requestors, Corning Shared Services, suppliers, internal customers, and cross-functional stakeholders on purchase requisition to order, invoice, supplier-documentation, system, and service issues. The role applies sound judgment within established policies and controls, identifies root causes and recurring issues, supports process improvements, and provides guidance and peer coaching to Procurement Operations Specialists.

Day to Day Responsibilities

- Independently manage complex procurement operational activities across R2P/P2P processes, ensuring timely, accurate, compliant, and customer-focused execution.

- Support Requestors with requisitioning, purchase-order creation and changes, purchase-order acknowledgements, change orders, approvals, voucher approvals, invoice exceptions, supplier communications, and urgent purchasing requirements.

- Serve as an escalation point for Procurement Operations Specialists on complex purchase-order, supplier, invoice, payment, documentation, system, policy, and customer-service issues; resolve issues within defined authority and escalate material risks or exceptions to the Lead, Procurement Operations.

- Coordinate with Corning Shared Services, suppliers, Buyers, Finance, and internal customers to resolve blocked invoices, payment issues, PO mismatches, supplier master-data issues, unconfirmed POs, service failures, and other business-impacting exceptions.

- Lead or coordinate urgent order-expediting activities, providing clear status updates, documenting actions, and escalating supply, delivery, compliance, or customer-impacting risks as appropriate.

- Review and maintain supplier documentation including agreements, NDAs, certificates of insurance, and supplier setup requirements; identify incomplete, expired, or non-compliant documentation for follow-up.

- Monitor procurement performance, work queues, backlogs, aging items, service levels, and exception trends; take action to address priorities and escalate performance risks promptly.

- Analyze recurring issues and root causes across procurement transactions, systems, suppliers, and processes; recommend and support corrective actions, standardization, and continuous-improvement opportunities.

- Support implementation and adoption of process changes, policies, system enhancements, workflow improvements, reporting, automation, and updated standard work.

- Maintain accurate procurement records and system data; support audit readiness, control testing, compliance reviews, issue remediation, and required documentation.

- Provide advanced guidance to internal customers on procurement policies, R2P/P2P processes, requisitioning, PO management, and system use.

- Coach and support Procurement Operations Specialists through knowledge sharing, peer review, cross-training, onboarding support, and reinforcement of standard work and quality expectations.

Required Skills

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, or a related field preferred.

- 4+ years of progressive experience in procurement operations, purchasing, supply chain, shared services, finance operations, or a related transactional environment.

- Demonstrated experience in R2P/P2P operations, including requisitioning, purchase-order management, supplier coordination, invoice/payment exception resolution, and stakeholder support.

- Experience using data, reports, or dashboards to monitor work queues, identify trends, prioritize actions, and support problem solving.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, judgment, communication, customer-service, and escalation-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and maintain accuracy and follow-through in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

- Advanced English proficiency, written and spoken.

- Strong ownership, judgment, and accountability.

- Customer-focused with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.

- Sense of urgency and ability to manage complex priorities calmly and effectively.

- Strong analytical thinking, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving capability.

- Effective conflict resolution and escalation management.

- High attention to detail, accuracy, compliance, and control awareness.

- Clear and influential communication with internal customers, suppliers, and cross-functional partners.

- Collaborative leadership through peer coaching, knowledge sharing, and positive influence.

- Adaptability and resilience during policy, process, system, and organizational changes.

Desired Skills

- Experience in a regional, global, multi-country, centralized procurement, or shared-services environment.

- Experience with Ariba supplier management, supplier onboarding, e-RFx, e-auctions, purchasing workflows, SAP/S4HANA, PeopleSoft, or comparable tools.

- Experience supporting procurement controls, SOX compliance, audit activities, issue remediation, or data-quality initiatives.

- Experience supporting process standardization, continuous improvement, workflow automation, system deployment, or user training.

- Advanced Excel, Power BI, or comparable reporting/analytics experience.

- Experience acting as a subject-matter resource, peer coach, workstream coordinator, or informal team lead.

- Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt/Green Belt, procurement, supply-chain, or operational-excellence certification.

- Additional language capability relevant to the region or stakeholder base.

Individuals with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs may request reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other benefits and privileges of employment. To submit a request for reasonable accommodation related to disability or religion, please contact us at accommodations@corning.com.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. ​

- Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives

- Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected

- Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light

- Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences

- Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation

Position Description

Scope of Position:
By combining supply chain domain expertise with deep analytical skills and advanced tools — including AI and Generative AI — we generate actionable insights that empower businesses to make strategic, impactful decisions.

Position Responsibilities:
•    Comprehend and convert business needs into technical specifications documents.
•    Design, prototype, and deploy GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., AI agents, copilots, RAG pipelines) that automate insight generation and augment analyst decision-making across GSM.
•    Apply prompt engineering and LLM orchestration techniques to build reliable, auditable AI workflows on enterprise data.
•    Apply unsupervised ML and statistical techniques to real supply chain datasets and translate outputs into actionable, business-ready recommendations.
•    Evaluate and responsibly deploy AI/ML outputs, applying judgment to validate accuracy, bias, and business relevance before insights reach stakeholders.

Required Skills (these are skills that candidate MUST possess)
•    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computing, science or related field.
•    Minimum 5-6 years of experience in similar role.
•    Working proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and building predictive/prescriptive models.
•    Hands-on experience applying Generative AI / LLM tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, ChatGPT/Claude) to real business or analytics workflows, including prompt engineering fundamentals.
•    Applied knowledge of  ML and statistical techniques (e.g., KMeans, Gaussian Mixture Models) to generate actionable business insights.
•    Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and modern data pipeline/ETL practices, including Delta Lake / Parquet-based architectures.
•    Highly skilled practitioner of business intelligence tools, especially Power BI, for data visualization and recommendations.
•    Experience in manufacturing and/or supply chain industries.

Desired Skills (these are additional skills that would differentiate the candidate) :
•    Experience building or integrating AI agents / agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain.
•    Exposure to MLOps practices (model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD for ML) and version control (Git).
•    Understanding of data governance and responsible AI principles (bias, explainability, data privacy) in an enterprise setting.
•    Experience with Microsoft Fabric or other unified analytics platforms.

Soft Skills (Communication/Team/Leadership)
•    Ability to articulate and convey complex technical solutions in simple, business-friendly terms to stakeholders at all levels.
•    Ability to collaborate with team members, functional and business stakeholders to deliver results.
•    Effectively juggling multiple projects and priorities to meet deadlines.
•    Critical thinking to evaluate, validate, and responsibly apply AI-generated outputs and recommendations rather than accepting them at face value.

Division / Company Marketing Statement
Global Supply Management (GSM) has played a central role in achieving the corporate fiscal objectives through delivering results on challenging corporate and business savings goals. The GSM Functional Strategy aligns the organization with businesses and corporate functional strategies. GSM support for the various functions like BD, Finance, and HR is a critical part of the mission. This is a very dynamic arena with opportunities to significantly impact Corning through identifying and executing cost reduction / avoidance opportunities, maximizing total value and minimizing risk. The breadth of this position also provides opportunities to develop and enhance a wide spectrum of procurement and applied-AI skills.

- Experience supporting financial close, forecasting, budgeting, and business performance analysis.

- Strong problem-solving and organizational skills.

- Ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights.

- Effective written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.

- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of PowerPoint and other reporting tools.

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you looking to enhance your career in a fast-paced environment and be part of an energetic team?

What is your role?

As Trade Compliance Specialist  you will play a pivotal role in coordinating and administering Corning’s trade compliance audit process. This role involves ensuring that all key aspects of our trade compliance program, such as Harmonized Tariff System Classification, Valuation, Country of Origin, and Free Trade Agreement are compliant with applicable laws, regulations, and policies set by the Trade Compliance COE. The Auditor will be responsible for interfacing with various Subject Matter Experts (SME) to validate that the information declared to Customs is correct.

Purpose and Major Responsibilities of Position:

- Execute trade compliance auditing in accordance with Corning’s auditing policy and procedures based on risk, value, and volumes.

- Work in multiple systems and manual environments with various formats to collect the right data and execute the expected analyses and results.

- Interface with multiple functional teams, potentially in different countries, to validate critical trade compliance data elements identified within import and/or export transactions.

- Identify non-conformance and trends within the data and present to functional data owners, as well as Trade Compliance management.

- Interface with Regional Business Unit Trade Compliance Managers to drive for corrective actions and closure on non-conformance.

- Manage information gathered during the auditing process and translate into clear and concise results messaging presentations.

- Initiate and drive meetings required to provide results or trends identified which may lead to changes within the risk categories.

- Support the development and implementation of compliance training programs.

What do you need to have?

- Bachelor’s Degree

- At least 4 years of experience in Trade Compliance or customs

- At least 2 years of Trade Compliance auditing experience

- Strong knowledge in HTS Classification, Country of Origin, & Valuation determination

- Advanced English

What we offer?

- Great benefits above law

- Growing environment that supports learning

- Equal opportunity employee

Scope of the role:

The Master Data Operations Supervisor leads a team responsible for maintaining accurate, timely, and compliant master data in SAP and related systems. This role combines frontline people leadership with hands-on contribution, ensuring stable daily operations.

Operating within established procedures, the Supervisor ensures high-quality execution of master data processes, resolves day-to-day issues, and escalates exceptions as needed. This role is critical to enabling effective planning, procurement, manufacturing, and financial processes through reliable system data.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead daily team operations  by directing Data Specialists, balancing workloads, monitoring queues/logs/reporting, adjusting priorities, and ensuring service levels, accuracy, and turnaround targets are met.

- Provide coaching and issue support  by training new team members and users, resolving routine delays or issues, and escalating more complex risks when needed.

- Oversee hands-on master data execution  including materials, BOMs, routings, related records, new part setup, and complex requests while ensuring readiness for downstream processes.

- Maintain data standards and governance  by ensuring updates follow established procedures, naming conventions, internal controls, and Data Office governance requirements.

- Drive data quality and compliance  through audits, reports, routine checks, deviation resolution, issue identification, escalation of systemic concerns, and audit readiness support.

- Coordinate cross-functionally  with planning, procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and finance while guiding stakeholders on data standards, supporting onboarding, and maintaining alignment across teams.

- Support SAP S/4HANA implementation  through data readiness, testing, validation, process standardization, adoption of new capabilities, and partnership with transformation teams for smooth stabilization.

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)

- 3-5 years plus in Master Data Governance, or Supply Chain ERP relevant experience

- Experience working in ERP systems, preferably SAP or SAP S/4HANA

- Experience managing or leading work in a transactional master data environment

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

- Ability to manage work in a structured, SLA-driven environment

- Effective communication and collaboration skills across functions

- Continuous improvement mindset and problem-solving capability
